popCulture.title: Bibliotheca (Hippocoon and Heracles)
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus tells how Hippocoon and his sons drove Tyndareus from Sparta until Heracles slew them and restored the throne — the Lacedaemonian usurper of the Heracles cycle.

popCulture.title: Description of Greece (Sparta)
popCulture.creator: Pausanias
popCulture.description: Pausanias keeps Hippocoon in the Spartan king-list and the Heracles vendetta that reseats Tyndareus — local Laconia’s memory of the coup.
